definitions.explanation: Medication used to lower high blood pressure.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{降圧薬|こうあつやく}を{飲|の}んでいる。
examples.english: I take blood pressure medication every morning.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}に{降圧薬|こうあつやく}を{処方|しょほう}された。
examples.english: I was prescribed antihypertensive medication by my doctor.

examples.japanese: {降圧薬|こうあつやく}は{自己判断|じこはんだん}でやめてはいけないので、{必|かなら}ず{医師|いし}と{相談|そうだん}してから{服用|ふくよう}を{調整|ちょうせい}するべきだ。
examples.english: You should not stop taking blood pressure medication on your own, so be sure to consult with your doctor before adjusting your dosage.

notes:
A compound of {降圧|こうあつ} (lowering blood pressure) and {薬|やく} (medicine). Also written as {降圧剤|こうあつざい} with {剤|ざい} instead of {薬|やく}; both are common and interchangeable.

Hypertension ({高血圧|こうけつあつ}) is one of the most prevalent health conditions in Japan, and {降圧薬|こうあつやく} is among the most commonly prescribed categories of medication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {降圧薬|こうあつやく}を{服用|ふくよう}する: to take antihypertensive medication
- {降圧薬|こうあつやく}を{処方|しょほう}する: to prescribe blood pressure medication
- {降圧薬|こうあつやく}の{副作用|ふくさよう}: side effects of blood pressure medication
- {降圧薬|こうあつやく}の{種類|しゅるい}: types of antihypertensives

RELATED TERMS:
- {降圧剤|こうあつざい}: antihypertensive (alternative form with {剤|ざい})
- {高血圧|こうけつあつ}: high blood pressure; hypertension
- {血圧|けつあつ}: blood pressure
- {処方薬|しょほうやく}: prescription medication
